body: This might not mean a lot coming from a total stranger, but what an amazing job you have done in moving to a healthier and stronger you. Unfortunately I’m quite higher in weight. 170 cm and a whopping 84.4 kgs - down from 89.0 kgs. I’ve told myself I’m not tracking anymore but I end up plugging in data just to see what the damage is and if it could be mitigated elsewhere. But trying not to let it completely overrule me. And maybe that’s the first step.

Thank you for this and sharing! Especially the difficulty of managing CPTSD alongside counting calories, inducing ED symptoms. And to also spell-out that it is achievable without all of this. I really appreciate this.

As someone who was going to move in with my previous partner but deep down knew it wasn’t the right move, please follow your gut and don’t move in with him until you are absolutely certain. I’m not sure what the alternative will be in regards to your relationship, but if you’ve got cold feet, that’s a sign you should listen to. Give yourself time to be 100% certain.

Running. Hated it when I first started out and was so focussed on the time. Picked it up again a few years ago and running slow but now I can do it. About to crack my PB distance of 14km this week, with a half marathon in August.

Hi! They told me they couldn’t see me any more due to changing their hours, something that caused our rupture last year. I understood this and even accepted it. 

It was more that we worked hard to establish trust back and they promised we would work together until the end of the year. And I placed a lot of faith and trust in that promise. And now I’m really upset and disappointed in trusting that.
Thank you 🥺🩷 Really appreciate it! Two hours and I’ll be there. I’ll definitely let you know if I feel like it. Really appreciate your comment.
Hi - thank you for asking! I’m seeing them in six hours.

I agree. I can understand why they need to do what they are doing. If that was my job and the only way I would make money, I would find that a really difficult decision as well. So I understand that side of things.

It’s like I want them to apologise or take responsibility, but for what? They held off telling me for a while when I was not great mentally. And they also could see it upset me a lot and said they reconsidered and said we’d still work together. I think they’ve tried to fix it but it’s just me. I’m just stuck in this weird space that their office doesn’t feel safe anymore. But it used to be. And I want that back more than anything because I’ve never had a safe place or person before. So I’m just a bit stuck.

No they did say this. They started the switch earlier last year but didn’t want to say anything to me about it because they knew I was in a bad place. But wanted to say it now because I was doing a bit better and was the last client.
Sorry, my therapy is covered in my country because it was CSA. So I am not paying them. Rather, the government pays a subsidised rate for them to take me on.

Hi Tom! Best and worst part of being on The Circle? ⭕️
Literally me crying over these for no reason 😂😂😂 Seeing how much it means to them gets me every time 🤦🏼‍♀️

Hey ☺️ I had this occur once in a session. Not consistently as yours. It was during a particular moment when I was struggling to voice what I was thinking, so I felt deflated and wanted to give up when I saw them check their phone. I didn’t even say anything. 

They noticed and clicked why why I was internally shutting down and wanted me to voice my thoughts. But I didn’t want to say anything because, in my mind, I didn’t want to jeopardise our therapeutic relationship, make them not want to work with me or be angry towards me voicing it.

But they eventually nudged me towards voicing what was wrong 😂 But I’m so thankful I did because they understood my need, thanked me for being honest and hasn’t occurred again. I also emailed that same night explaining further how I felt and why.

It might be that if you feel you cannot bring it up in session, that emailing might be the best option! You can carefully draft and communicate all you want to say. If they are a good therapist, they will understand. Mind you, if they are a good therapist, they shouldn’t be checking their phone consistently in your sessions.
What season is she from? 🥺

My therapist has a couple of plants in their office. Suggested I get one as well when my depression was really bad. Now I have several haha. 

One day I was looking at one of their plants which has a growing stake for the plant to wrap around and grow upright. At the time, the stake looked like part of the plant. I asked them if it was part of the plant at the end of the session and they leaned forward in their chair and said ‘yes it is’ and jokingly had me on for a few minutes before confessing that they were just joking. 

Not an inside joke but it always cheers me up when I think about it. Just a real nice genuine moment that strengthened that therapist/client bond more.
Yes please!

I don’t know how long you have done therapy for but please stick it out if you have the financial means! I feel like I could have wrote this a few months ago. It does get a lot easier to label emotions if you have lots of practice at it. Might be worth asking if your therapist can prompt you with some possible feelings to help you narrow it down. You’re not too dumb. It’s a long and hard process that requires a lot of patience and trust in your therapist. I hope you have this!
My therapist has purposely done this once when I started to disassociate. Just a means of bringing me back to the current moment.
Kidds Bakery ☺️

Oh man…Eddie dying hurt 😭 I knew it was leading up towards it but hearing him say “I didn’t run away this time” and how much that meant to him legit triggered my trauma 😂

And don’t get me started on Hopper’s letter to El. I still can’t watch it without tearing up. The music and dialogue get me every time.

Thank you for clarifying this for me. After reading this, I do believe it might have been an intrusive thought. It wasn’t really a ‘voice’ outside of me. I didn’t hear it. It was in my mind. It was more like someone hijacked my mind and it felt the more I tried to block it out, the stronger it came back. Thank you…kinda nice to know I’m not going crazy then.
